description: Search and filter invoices by various criteria. Returns a response with top-level "primary_currency" and "currency_warning" fields. Each invoice includes explicit "currency", "comparable" (true if matches primary currency), and "converted_to_primary" fields alongside separate numeric "amount_gross", "amount_net", and "tax_amount" values. Also has TWO status fields: "processing_status" (pending/processing/completed/paid) and "payment_status" (paid/unpaid). Amounts in different currencies are NOT directly comparable or summable. Also includes tags/categories for each invoice in the response. converted_to_primary is null when no conversion data exists, or { amount, currency, source } when a bank reconciliation has recorded the actual settlement amount in the user's primary currency. Requires the Start or Business plan.

status.description: Filter by processing_status (OCR workflow stage). Note: completed means OCR is done but NOT necessarily paid; the payment_status field in results reflects the actual payment state.

tag.description: Filter by a single tag name (partial match)

name: query_invoices
